name: Open Charge Map API
summary: Global crowd-sourced registry of EV charging locations.
description: POI endpoint returns charging stations with connectors, power levels, operators, usage cost and status, searchable by location radius, country or bounding box. Reference-data endpoint lists connection types and operators.

auth.notes: Free key; may also be sent as the key query parameter.

rate_limit.summary: No hard published number; fair use; key identifies app

example.response_excerpt: You must specify an API key using the key query parameter or x-api-key header.

agent_notes: A free key is required; without one the API returns 403. Search /poi by latitude, longitude and distance, and use compact=true to cut payload size.
caveats: Requires a free key; the unauthenticated endpoint returns 403 with a message asking for one.

verification.notes: Only the unauthenticated 403 response (asking for a key) was observed.
